messages:
maria.k: Quick coordination — planning to pin + canary deploy verdant-4b-v1.2 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need: deploy owner, smoke owner, rollback owner. TL;DR checklist below.

maria.k: Checklist:
• Pin model in catalog (config snippet below)
• Canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~90m
• Smoke: latency + correctness prompts, embedding sanity, token-accounting
• Rollback: switch pin back to verdant-4b-v1.1 and squeeze traffic to fallback pool

jordan: I can own the deploy (will be on call).

alex_t: I’ll take smoke & perf. Can someone confirm p95 target and a short smoke script I should run?

maria.k: Target: p95 <= 150ms for 128-token gen on dedicated pool. Abort threshold: any p95 > 300ms or >2% error/timeout. Smoke script (quick):

```bash
# sample smoke load (small)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model": "verdant-4b-v1.2", "input": "Write a 2-line friendly summary of the following: The system started returning 503s.", "max_tokens": 64}'
```

alex_t: thanks — I’ll run that in staging then in canary window and paste perf numbers. I’ll also run a couple eval prompts from the prompt-suite PR.

samuel: Quick CR ping — PR #345 (catalog pin + metadata) is awaiting approval. @liz_infra can you give it a quick config check?

liz_infra: on it. Noted we need the host affinity tag for dedicated GPU pool. Also confirm quantization profile: we’ll serve FP16 and a 4-bit quant variant as fallback.

maria.k: pin config (catalog patch):

```yaml
models:
  verdant-4b:
    pin: verdant-4b-v1.2
    rollout_policy:
      canary: 0.05
      ramp: [0.2, 1.0]
    fallbacks:
      - name: verdant-4b-v1.1-4bit
        reason: capacity/latency fallback
    tags: [stable, q2-onboard]
```

liz_infra: also adding pool tag: dedicated:inference-west-us and kms_policy: customer. OK from infra side once PR updated.

jordan: timeline check — 09:00 PT start, canary 30m -> ramp 60m. Want people on Slack/Zoom for first 20m. I’ll schedule the ad-hoc zoom.

alex_t: one more ask — if we see a drop in token-quality (regression vs v1.1 on eval suite) >5% we should auto-pause. I’ll produce the eval diff before deploy and attach thresholds.

maria.k: perfecto. I’ll add the eval thresholds to the PR description. Also tagging support for quick rollback if we need infra changes.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary job verdant-4b-v1.2 at 2025-03-13T09:00:00-07:00 (owner: jordan).

alex_t: staging smoke passed (p95 120ms, 0.3% errors) — will rerun at canary.

samuel: PR #345 approved from product side. 

maria.k: final owners: deploy=jordan, smoke=alex_t, rollback=liz_infra. Zoom link in calendar invite. Thanks all, will post post-deploy checklist results here. :thumbsup:

alex_t: noted — will report back during window.

liz_infra: I’ll be on-call for rollback steps. Keep me pinged and include heatmap from console if we hit >200ms p95.

jordan: got it — see you at 09:00 PT. Good prep everyone.
